contents: Adjusted the style of the More menu
Added likes and comments to the home page (show-home-memo-engagement)
Added support for adding image links in articles
Improved the push logic for update announcements and notifications
Added the ability to return to the main screen from the Drafts and Collections screens
Added support for moving articles being edited to Drafts
Fixed an issue where the keyboard could not be brought up automatically after switching screens
Fixed an issue where tags could not be closed (fix-tag-autocomplete-overlay-picker-lifecycle)
Fixed an issue where Xiaohongshu could not be clipped
